data.text: Luke, you shouldn’t have to give up your income to join us. My family has fished this lake for generations, and I’d rather keep it healthy for everyone in the village. Let’s each take 10 tons this month: we’d earn $10,000 apiece, leave 50 tons, and have 100 again next month. That gives all five of us an equal, sustainable income if we stick to it. I’ll commit to 10 tons under that agreement. John, will you join me?
